name: manual_d78426
claim: When endpoint-policy exceptions can retain raw addresses or URLs, logs and stderr must emit only redacted fields rather than exception text or raw endpoint values.

decisions.notes: The PR352 review recorded endpoint and exception redaction as a security lesson. This captures the bounded rule independently of its branch-local security implementation.
